notes.title: Pals Go Only Up! soon to be available for everyone to play.
notes.content:
[h1]Pals Go Only Up![/h1]

A very difficult platforming game designed to be as punishing as fair, is going to be available very soon. In a matter of weeks. Will you be prepared to overcome the challenge?
